description:
***Promotional oneshot for the novel.***

One day I was in a world that I did not know.  
[The introduction to the quest has been successfully completed! ].

[Quest (Main) - «Fix the world!».   
Content: This world was created by mixing four novels: Child Care, Contract Marriage, XXX, XXX. Genres are unknown. You must return the four distorted novels to the original. ].

But... I have no memory of their content. If I make a mistake... then I’m going to die?! Besides, the distorted web novel characters are interested in me! What should I do?!

[Original Novel](https://page.kakao.com/home/%EB%A1%9C%ED%8C%90%EC%9D%84-%EB%AA%A8%EB%A5%B4%EB%A9%B4-%EC%A3%BD%EC%8A%B5%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/57460343)
